queries: Anthropic S-1 filing net loss 2024 operating loss SEC
Anthropic computer use public beta announcement

sources_considered.why: Primary filing (S-1, filed 2026-10-26) with product launch history and 2024 revenue by type.
Company announcement of a paid business plan in September 2024.
Company announcement of Computer Use, with its own caveats about performance.

evidence_items.locator: Risk Factors, 'We have a limited operating history' paragraph

receipt.public_excerpt:
We were founded in 2021 and launched our first commercial product, Claude, publicly in the first quarter of

2023.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic says it launched Claude as a commercial product in early 2023, about two years before the post.

evidence_items.locator: MD&A, Comparison of the Years Ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, Revenue

receipt.public_excerpt:
Revenue for the year ended December 31, 2024 increased by $345 million, or 841%, compared to the year

ended December 31, 2023. Consumption-based and subscription-based revenue increased by approximately

$249 million and $96 million, respectively

evidence_items.explanation: In 2024 Anthropic earned growing revenue from both usage-based (API) and subscription products. That shows its LLM was sold as products, not a total failure to productize.

metric_scope.metric: revenue (change, by consumption and subscription type)

receipt.public_excerpt: Today, we’re announcing the Claude Enterprise plan to help organizations securely collaborate with Claude using internal knowledge.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic launched and promoted a paid enterprise product five months before the post, so Computer Use was not its only pushed product.

evidence_items.locator: paragraph on computer use public beta

receipt.public_excerpt: At this stage, it is still experimental—at times cumbersome and error-prone.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic itself called Computer Use experimental, cumbersome and error-prone. This fits the speaker's description of Computer Use, though not the wider productization claim.

unresolved_gaps: No timed, independent test of Computer Use against human browser speed was found, so the 'minutes versus seconds' remark is unmeasured.
The S-1 does not split 2024 revenue by individual product.
